children: U.S. vehicle sales for Ford Motor
edged down 0.8% year over year to 174,123 units in October, as a steep decline in electric vehicle deliveries offset growth in truck sales.

Sales of electric vehicles plunged 71.2% to 1,355 units, while hybrid sales fell 21% to 13,818. Combined sales of electrified vehicles, including hybrids and EVs, dropped 31.7% to 15,173 units. Sales of internal combustion vehicles, meanwhile, rose 3.6% to 158,950.
Truck sales increased 2.3% to 108,175 units, supported by an 8.2% rise in F-Series deliveries to 73,482. SUV sales declined 4.7% to 62,856 units, while car sales fell 19.6% to 3,092.
Among individual models, Explorer sales climbed 35.2% to 23,885 units, while Expedition deliveries increased 56.7% to 8,546. Mustang Mach-E sales fell 57.4% to 1,239 units.
For the first 10 months of 2026, the total U.S. sales for The Blue Oval declined 7.9% to 1.69 million vehicles. Electrified vehicle sales were down 33.3% over the same period.
Shares were trading about 4% higher on Wednesday.

title: Ford October U.S. sales slip as electric vehicle deliveries plunge
